stem:
Meena and Arjun are discussing how to learn science well in Class 7.

Which ways of learning science go beyond the book and help us observe, do activities, and experiment with the world around us?

1  Reading the chapter silently and memorising the names of topics without trying anything.
2  Collecting leaves from the school garden and observing their shapes and veins carefully.
3  Copying the textbook answers neatly into the notebook for the test.
4  Doing a simple home experiment with water and salt to see which things dissolve.

statements.text: Reading the chapter silently and memorising the names of topics without trying anything.
Collecting leaves from the school garden and observing their shapes and veins carefully.
Copying the textbook answers neatly into the notebook for the test.
Doing a simple home experiment with water and salt to see which things dissolve.

teacher.key_rationale: Statements 2 and 4 involve observing the world and experimenting, which extend learning beyond the book; statements 1 and 3 stay inside reading and copying, so the keyed set is 2 and 4, option C. Option A is the trap for a student who believes memorising the book alone counts as learning science.
